findings.title: SQL Injection in Payment Processing API (Production Gateway)
findings.description: Blind SQL injection allows authenticated extraction of credit card and transaction tables on production internet-facing cluster.
findings.solution: Use parameterized queries with prepared statements; sanitize input via strict ORM filters.

findings.title: SQL Injection in Test Mock Database (Isolated Sandbox Node)
findings.description: Identical SQL injection vulnerability present in an isolated sandbox unit containing dummy fixtures with no customer data and local admin auth barrier.
findings.solution: Update development template and apply parameterized queries.

findings.title: Citrix ShareFile Cryptographic Flaw & Storage Manipulation
findings.description: Improper access control in ShareFile storage zones controller allowing unauthenticated arbitrary file upload.
findings.solution: Upgrade Citrix ShareFile storage zones controller to 5.11.24 or later.

findings.title: Hardcoded Administrative Secret on Internal JIRA Server
findings.description: Hardcoded default secret key on internal server behind corporate subnet and SSO requiring high privileges to abuse.
findings.solution: Rotate JWT signing key and enable automated secret vault injection.

findings.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI Remote Code Execution (Auth Gateway)
findings.description: Log4Shell RCE in DMZ identity gateway. Public exploits available and active scanning detected.
findings.solution: Upgrade Log4j to 2.17.1 or newer; set formatMsgNoLookups=true.

findings.title: Fortinet FortiOS SSL-VPN Remote Code Execution
findings.description: Pre-auth out-of-bounds write in FortiOS web proxy allows unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.
findings.solution: Apply FortiOS vendor patch immediately or disable SSL VPN web portal.

findings.title: MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection & Unauthorized Access
findings.description: SQL injection in DMZ mail relay / file exchange appliance leading to session impersonation and arbitrary code execution.
findings.solution: Apply Progress Software May 2023 patch set.

findings.title: Fortinet FortiOS SSL-VPN Heap Buffer Overflow
findings.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in FortiOS and FortiProxy SSL-VPN allows pre-auth remote code execution.

findings.title: Spring Framework RCE (Spring4Shell) on Staging API
findings.description: Spring Framework RCE on non-production internal staging environment requiring adjacent network access and auth.

findings.title: Atlassian Confluence Server OGNL Injection
findings.description: OGNL evaluation allows authenticated internal users to execute shell commands on HR database host.
findings.solution: Apply Atlassian security advisory patch for Confluence Server.

findings.title: curl SOCKS5 Heap Buffer Overflow (Spark Processing Cluster)
findings.description: curl heap overflow on isolated internal compute engine with local execution access.
findings.solution: Update curl to 8.4.0 or rebuild package without SOCKS5 proxy resolver.

findings.title: Deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 Protocols Active on Cold Storage NAS
findings.description: Legacy cipher suites permitted on isolated offline archive appliance.
findings.solution: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1; enforce TLS 1.2 or 1.3 only.

findings.title: libwebp Heap Buffer Overflow (Customer Portal Asset Service)
findings.description: Client-facing avatar processing endpoint parses malicious webp image leading to memory corruption.
findings.solution: Update libwebp to version 1.3.2 across web application base images.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
findings.description: Customer portal web server does not announce HSTS header, allowing man-in-the-middle downgrade.
findings.solution: Set Strict-Transport-Security header with max-age of at least 31536000 seconds.

findings.title: Server Information Disclosure in HTTP Response Headers
findings.description: Internal staging server returns Server: Apache/2.4.41 (Ubuntu) header banner.
findings.solution: Configure ServerTokens Prod and ServerSignature Off in web server configuration.
